notes: New Alerts screen: create an alert for a course, date and time window without touching GitHub.
Live match count while you build a rule, so you can see straight away whether it is too narrow or far too broad.
Toggle alerts on and off, or delete them, from the same screen. Alerts whose date has passed are flagged.
Connects with a fine-grained GitHub token you paste in once, scoped to this repo only and stored on your phone.
Service worker no longer touches cross-origin requests, so authenticated API calls are never cached.
